snippet.title: Battlefield 1918 20th Anniversary Trailer
snippet.description:
Today the Battlefield 1918 Mod Development Team is proud to announce the release of Battlefield 1918 20th Anniversary Edition which was made in celebration of the first release of Battlefield 1918 on March 26th of 2004.

Full Version:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/battlefield-1918/downloads/battlefield-1918-20th-anniversary-edition-full
